scope: Real default SDE builder and Worker; actual supervisor and forked runtime generations, HTTP and dashboard/Stream SSE.
Two synthetic pilots, 20,000 assets each, 50,000 events, 200 Sessions, 8 Maps with 100 nodes each; real Core scheduler and synthetic cached/provider responses.
Archive streams from local disk; Internet download time excluded. No browser/OBS executable or real private data.
Per-generation CPU/RSS/event-loop measures include the real SDE worker. RSS is process-wide, sampled peaks are lower bounds. Quiet controls mean the same loaded app without conversion.
Automatic dataset startup check is suppressed only by the analysis adapter; installation begins at 5s. All other Core drivers remain enabled.
